subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
12. CA Ravi Chopra considered the subsequent events which require to be dealt
with in the financial statements. Select from the below options, the one which
is not an event, providing evidence of conditions that arose after the date of
the financial statements:
(A)  Settling a legal claim outside the court at a reduced amount, between
the date of financial statements and the date of auditor's report, for
which provision has already been made in financial statements.
(B)  Issue of new share capital.
(C)  Planned merger of the company.
(D)  Destruction of substantial inventories due to fire between the date of the
financial statements and the date of auditor's report.
(2 Marks)
